reason: The concept holds up: a zero-cost, text-only outcome table committed before any private score. It needs no slot, kernel or runtime, and R8 does not apply because it adds no mechanism. The sign rule is sound: rounding is monotone, and our kernels are deterministic run to run (CONTEXT l.796, l.1574, l.1909), so a non-zero displayed contrast has the true sign. It adds no score (calibration only). The table as written must NOT be recorded verbatim, because it has five logic faults. (1) Not exhaustive: C1 > 0 with C2 = 0 matches no row. (2) Rows overlap: C1 < C2 < 0 fires both O-D and O-E, and no precedence is given. (3) O-D's rule 'C1 >= 0 => stack interaction' breaks its own displayed-0 rule. With C1 shown as 0 the true C1 can be -0.0008 while the true C2 is -0.0001, so no interaction is proven; only a displayed C1 > 0 proves true C1 > 0 > true C2. (4) Comparing two contrasts (O-E 'C1 < C2') carries up to 2 units of rounding error: true(C2 - C1) = displayed +/- <2, so an order is proven only when the displayed gap is >= 2. (5) The C3 promotion over-infers. Lowrefine touches ~0.02% of nodes (+28 of 121,252 dummy nodes), so a displayed +/-1 is most likely a ~1e-4 true effect that happens to cross a rounding boundary. Promoting items 2-3 (bar: lab >= +0.012) on that is not justified. Scope is also stale. The 20:33 UTC user decision lifted R7 and made the finals one public-aimed file plus one private-aimed file, and K2-variant probes will be scored tonight. The table must say that only the #34/#35/P36/#37/#38 contrasts are pre-registered and any later file is post-hoc.
fix: Before recording, rewrite the table as FIRST-MATCH-WINS over displayed contrasts in thousandths: (i) C2 < 0 and C1 > 0 -> stack interaction (proven; lowrefine suspect, lesson 'test riders on the final stack'); (ii) C2 < 0 -> insertion embryo-specific on the finals stack, demote item 6; (iii) C1 > 0 and C2 > 0 -> O-A promote item 6; (iv) C2 > 0 and C1 <= 0 -> O-B, clean on the K2 stack, C1 unresolved (rounding or #35 degrade); (v) C1 > 0 and C2 = 0 -> NEW row O-F: positive on plain x138 only, weak, no promotion, possible stack interaction, R12P-5 decides; (vi) C1 < 0 and C2 = 0 -> O-E, #35 degrade or harm, not separable; (vii) C1 = C2 = 0 -> O-C uninformative. Any claim that orders C1 against C2 needs |C2 - C1| >= 2 displayed. C3: promote items 2-3 only if C3 >= +2, and demote lowrefine-type riders only if C3 <= -2. Otherwise record 'sign only, magnitude < ~0.002, no action'. C4 stays as written. Add a scope line: 'Pre-registered contrasts cover only #34, #35, P36, #37 and #38. Every file submitted after 26 Sep 20:33 UTC (public-probe ladder, the new public/private finals) is outside this table, and any reading of it is post-hoc.' Commit the line and quote the commit hash in the round-12 record.
realistic_gain: 0 on the LB (calibration only, no finals effect). The value is a cleaner post-deadline priority read, and only when displayed contrasts are >= 1 (insertion rows) or >= 2 (C3 and C1-vs-C2 ordering).
